title: Redwood Controls quality-of-earnings normalization
prompt:
Normalize Redwood Controls' LTM EBITDA for acquisition underwriting.

Use the July corporate-development investment-committee correspondence, the 7/5 controller-tied IC book, the current data-room export, the diligence review notes, and the approved underwriting policy. Treat the 6/29 banker case as change history only.

Rebuild reported EBITDA from Redwood's twelve-month target P&L and evaluate each proposed adjustment against the diligence evidence. Include supported seller-period nonrecurring items and documented run-rate costs; exclude buyer synergies and uncommitted savings. Return the accepted and rejected adjustment names, normalized EBITDA and margin, and the largest remaining QoE risk under the policy's risk-ranking basis.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `reported_ebitda`, `accepted_adjustments`, `rejected_adjustments`, `normalized_ebitda`, `normalized_ebitda_margin`, `largest_remaining_qoe_risk`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
